title: An inactive part cannot be picked anywhere parts are added
custom_preconds:
1. You are on the Parts -> Inventory page on the build under test, with permission to view inventory parts.
  2. You hold the "Part Library & Inventory - Delete" permission (needed to change status/tracking).
  3. A part that is currently inactive (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST-PKG-1", deactivated).
custom_steps:
1. Search for the inactive part in the part lookup on: a work order line, an estimate line, technician charge-out, a standalone invoice line, a purchase order line, a vendor bill line.
  2. Search for it via barcode/scan lookup, a parts return, a part sale credit, and a part sale line.
  3. Confirm it is not returned in any of them.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Part lookup does not return inactive parts on a work order line, an estimate line, technician charge-out selection, a standalone invoice line, a purchase order line, a vendor bill line, barcode/scan lookup, a parts return, a part sale credit, or a part sale line.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; "Parts Lifecycle Update" PRD (Confluence 829227015, IN REVIEW 2026-09-09), Story 9 (Inactive parts cannot be selected); design canvas Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026 against an IN-REVIEW spec; not yet build-verified.
